jobs.title: Oracle Fusion Cloud Lead-Logistics & Supply Chain Management
jobs.description:
Oracle Fusion Cloud Lead — Logistics & Supply Chain Management

Greenfield Oracle Fusion Implementation

Company Tessera Labs AI

Role Type Senior consulting engagement — full-time or contract, workstream-critical role

Location Nearshore, based in Mexico or Brazil — remote-based delivery model; excellent business

English required for direct engagement with client stakeholders and leadership

Reports To Program Director / Engagement Lead, Tessera Labs AI

About the Role

Tessera Labs AI is a technology product firm delivering next-generation, AI-accelerated enterprise transformation programs. We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Lead to own the Logistics and Supply Chain Management (SCM) workstream for a greenfield Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation for a fast-growing client.

This is a greenfield implementation from a process and configuration standpoint — there is no legacy SCM configuration to reverse-engineer or carry forward, and the opportunity is to stand up Oracle Fusion Cloud Inventory Management, Order Management, Indirect Procurement and related logistics processes from a blank slate, configured to Oracle standard wherever possible. Data is a different story: item, article, inventory, and other master and historical data still needs to be extracted, transformed, and loaded (ETL) from the client's legacy ERP into Oracle Fusion, and this role supports that migration effort alongside the functional design work.

This is a highly cross-functional, business-facing role. You will run discovery and design workshops directly with logistics, supply chain, and procurement stakeholders — including ownership of the Indirect Procurement value stream — translate their requirements into working Oracle Fusion design and configuration, and own the documentation trail from business requirement through configuration and test. You will also own the integration design connecting Oracle Fusion to Shopify for e-commerce order and inventory synchronization, and to the client'swarehouse management system(s) for outbound and inbound logistics — alongside integration with adjacent Oracle Fusion modules as applicable.

This is a nearshore delivery role, based in Mexico or Brazil, working in a remote-first model alongside Tessera's distributed FDE delivery and AI engineering teams. Because you will be running workshops and presenting directly tobusiness stakeholders and client leadership, excellent business English — spoken and written — is essential to this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and facilitate business process workshops with logistics, supply chain, procurement, and operations stakeholders to capture requirements for a greenfield Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation, spanning Inventory Management, Order Management, Indirect Procurement, and related logistics processes.

• Own end-to-end functional configuration of Oracle Fusion modules — Inventory Management, Order

Management, and Procurement, with particular ownership of the Indirect Procurement value stream,

translating workshop outcomes into a working, standard-first system design.

• Configure and maintain the Oracle article/item master setup in line with fashion and apparel industry best practices (e.g., style, color, and size hierarchies, seasonal and pre-pack/kit structures) and Oracle Retail conventions.

jobs.title: Technical GRC Analyst (Compliance & Assurance)
jobs.description:
Technical GRC Analyst (Compliance & Assurance)

As part of the Tessera Lab Compliance & Assurance team, you'll help build and maintain trust by partnering across the business to provide practical, risk-based compliance and assurance that enables the company to scale with confidence.

As a Technical GRC Analyst, you'll partner with Security, Engineering, Product, and business teams to evaluate technical controls, validate evidence, assess risk, and continuously improve the organization's compliance and assurance program.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys understanding how technology works, asking thoughtful questions, solving problems, and helping build a modern compliance program that scales with the business.

Your Focus Areas

 - Technical Control Assurance and Risk Assessments

 - AI Governance & Emerging Technologies (ISO 42001)

 - Technical Customer Assurance

 - Program Intelligence, Metrics & Analytics

 - Compliance Automation & Continuous Improvement

Key Responsibilities

 - Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of technical controls.

 - Review and validate evidence to assess whether controls are implemented, operating effectively, and appropriately documented.

 - Perform technical risk assessments for new technologies, systems, and business initiatives.

 - Partner with Engineering and Security to ensure technical controls align with compliance requirements and industry best practices.

 - Support and continuously improve the company’s AI governance program — AI policies, acceptable-use standards, risk assessments, vendor evaluations, and security controls aligned with ISO 42001.

 - Transform compliance data into meaningful insights that support business decisions and program maturity.

 - Identify opportunities to automate compliance activities and improve operational efficiency.

 - Support internal assessments, customer due diligence, and external audits.

What You'll Bring

Experience

 - 8+ years of experience in technical security, Security GRC, regulatory compliance, or a related discipline.

 - Experience evaluating technical controls and validating supporting evidence.

 - Experience performing technical risk assessments and working with cross-functional teams.

 - Experience working in technology organizations with modern cloud and enterprise environments.

 - Exposure to FedRAMP authorization activities including NIST 800-53 control implementation, SSP development, evidence collection, POA&M management, or readiness assessments is highly desirable.

Working knowledge in several of the following areas:

 - Cloud and security architecture concepts

 - Vulnerability and risk management

 - Secure software development and DevSecOps concepts

 - Data protection and encryption

 - AI governance and emerging technologies

 - Dashboard development, reporting,analytics and automation

You're someone who:

 - Enjoys understanding how technology works and asking thoughtful questions.

 - Can translate technical concepts into practical compliance conversations

 - Exercise sound judgment when evaluating controls, validating evidence, and balancing compliance requirements with practical business needs.

 - Builds trusted relationships across teams.

 - Takes ownership and enjoys improving processes.

 - Thrives in a fast-paced startup environment.

What Success Looks Like

 - Technical controls are consistently evaluated and continuously improved.

 - Leadership has meaningful visibility into technical risks and control effectiveness.

 - Dashboards and metrics support informed business decisions.

 - Customer and audit activities are well supported through high-quality evidence and strong technical assurance.
